blocks.text: Electric field ko tasveer ki shakal mein electric field lines se dikhaya jata hai; yeh khayal Michael Faraday ka hai. Field lines ek map (naqsha) hain jo charged cheez ke gird field ki direction aur taqat dikhati hain. Chunke yeh charged cheez par lagne wali force batati hain, inhein “electric lines of force” bhi kehte hain.

Field lines samjhane ke liye positive test charges +q₀ (har ek ki magnitude q₀) ko positive charge +q se barabar faasle par mukhtalif jagahon par rakhte hain (Fig. 9.5). Har test charge par dhakelne wali force lagti hai, jaise Fig. 9.5(a) mein teer dikhate hain. Is liye +q ki field centre (beech ka point) se bahar ki taraf (radially outward) hai. Fig. 9.5(b) yehi field lines dikhati hai. Fig. 9.6 negative (manfi) charge −q ke qareeb field lines dikhati hai: yahan lines andar ki taraf (radially inward) hain, kyun ke ab positive test charge par kheenchne wali force lagti hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Markazi charge +q ke gird dotted dairay par aath chhote narangi test charges +q0; har ek se magenta teer bahar ki taraf. (b) +q se har direction seedhi field lines jin ke teer bahar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.5: (a) positive point charge +q ke qareeb positive test charge +q0 par repulsion ki force bahar ki taraf; (b) field lines +q se bahar ki taraf (kitab ki Figure 9.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Neela charge -q, har direction se seedhi field lines aati hain; teer andar -q ki taraf.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.6: Field lines negative point charge -q ki taraf andar ko (kitab ki Figure 9.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field line ki direction woh hai jidhar positive test charge par force lage. +q positive test charge ko dhakelta hai (lines bahar), −q kheenchta hai (lines andar).
Figures 9.5 aur 9.6 do-dimensional (kaghaz par chapti) tasveerein hain. Asal mein field lines charges se teeno dimensions mein har taraf nikalti hain, aur be-shumaar lines banayi ja sakti hain.

Field lines ka “naqsha” field strength bhi batata hai. Figs. 9.5 aur 9.6 mein charges ke qareeb lines ek doosre ke qareeb hain, jahan field strong hai; door ja kar lines phailti jati hain, yani field strength lagatar kam hoti jati hai.

blocks.title: Field lines aur field strength
blocks.text: Kisi surface (satah) se seedhi (perpendicular) guzarne wali lines ki number (ginti) fi unit area, electric field ki magnitude ke proportional hoti hai.

Do aik jaise charges thore faasle par hon to lines curved (mura hua) ho jati hain. Fig. 9.7 do barabar positive point charges ki lines dikhati hai: dono ke darmiyan lines ek doosre ko dhakelti nazar aati hain. Do aik jaise negative charges ka pattern bilkul aisa hi hota hai (sirf teer ulte). Beech mein ek zero field spot ya neutral zone hota hai.

blocks.alt: Do barabar positive charges +q pehlu ba pehlu. Har charge se lines har direction nikalti aur doosre charge se door mur jati hain; darmiyan mein khali jagah (neutral zone) jahan field sifar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.7: do aik jaise positive point charges ki field lines (kitab ki Figure 9.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Fig. 9.7 ki caption "two identical opposite point charges" kehti hai, magar tasveer aur text dono do aik jaise positive charges ki baat karte hain; yahan caption sahi likhi gayi hai. Beech mein dono fields barabar aur ulti hain, is liye wahan field zero hai.

Fig. 9.8 barabar magnitude ke do opposite (ulta) charges ka pattern dikhati hai. Lines positive charge se shuru ho kar negative charge par khatam hoti hain. Points 1, 2, 3 par field dono charges ki fields ka resultant (kul nateeja) hai. Har point par resultant field ki direction us point par field line ke tangent (chhoone wali seedhi lakeer) se milti hai.

blocks.alt: Baen positive +q aur daen negative -q. Lines +q se nikal kar mur kar -q par khatam hoti hain; bahar ki kuch lines +q se tasveer se bahar jati aur kuch bahar se -q mein aati hain. Teen lines par nuqte 1, 2, 3 par chhote surkh teer tangent ke saath.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.8: barabar magnitude ke do opposite charges ki field lines (kitab ki Figure 9.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne Fig. 9.8 ke neeche Fig. 9.6 wali caption ("radially inward towards a negative point charge −q") dobara chhaap di hai. Yeh tasveer do opposite charges ki hai; yahan caption sahi likhi gayi hai.

Jahan field lines parallel (mutawazi) aur barabar faasle par hon, wahan har unit area se utni hi lines guzarti hain, is liye field har point par uniform (ek jaisa) hoti hai. Fig. 9.9 parallel plate capacitor ki plates ke darmiyan lines dikhati hai: beech ke hisse mein lines barabar faasle par hain, is liye wahan field uniform hai.

blocks.alt: Do khari plates, baen +, daen -. Darmiyan parallel, barabar faasle wali lines + se - ki taraf. Kinaron ke qareeb lines bahar ko kham khati hain; bahar + plate se lines baen taraf jati aur daen taraf se - plate mein aati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.9: parallel plate capacitor ke darmiyani hisse mein field lines parallel aur barabar faasle par hain, yani field har jagah ek si hai (kitab ki Figure 9.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Beech mein lines parallel aur barabar faasle par hain, is liye wahan field uniform hai. Kinaron par lines baahar ko mur jati hain (fringing); wahan field uniform nahi.
Ab hum field lines ki properties (khoobiyan) ka khulasa kar sakte hain:

items: Field lines positive charges se shuru hoti hain aur negative charges par khatam hoti hain.
Kisi point par field line ka tangent us point par electric field ki direction batata hai.
Jahan field strong ho wahan lines qareeb hoti hain, jahan kamzor ho wahan door door.
Do lines kabhi ek doosre ko nahi kaatti, kyun ke kisi point par E ki sirf ek direction hoti hai. Agar lines kaatti to us point par E ki do directions hoti, jo mumkin nahi.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: Conductor ke andar koi electric field nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: Electric lines of force ek doosre ko kyun nahi kaatti (constructed response 9.1)? +20 μC ka particle 10 cm door do parallel plates ke darmiyan hai jin par 0.5 kV ka potential difference hai; field aur force nikalein (numerical 9.2). 100 μC charge wali 0.1 N weight ki gend do charged horizontal (ufuqi) plates ke darmiyan ruki rehti hai; E nikalein (MCQ 9.6).
blocks.explanation: Line ka tangent kisi point par E ki direction deta hai, aur har point par E ki sirf ek direction hoti hai; kaatne wali lines us point par do directions deti. E = V/d = 500 V/0.10 m = 5 × 10³ N C⁻¹ = 5 kN C⁻¹; F = qE = 20 × 10⁻⁶ C × 5 × 10³ N C⁻¹ = 0.1 N = 100 mN. Gend ke liye qE = mg, is liye E = 0.1 N/(100 × 10⁻⁶ C) = 1000 N C⁻¹: option (c).

items: Electric field: unit positive charge par force, E = F/q (9.8), unit N C⁻¹, F ki direction mein vector; F = qE (9.9).
Example 9.2: q₂ = 4 μC se 1.0 m par E = 0. Example 9.3: E = 1.0 × 10⁻⁷ N C⁻¹.

Field lines (Faraday): + se bahar, − ki taraf andar; lines ki ghanayi E ke proportional; do aik jaise charges ke darmiyan neutral zone; opposite charges mein + se −; plates ke darmiyan parallel aur uniform; kabhi nahi kaatti.
